subject: ventures/freelancer-schedule-c-categorizer
professional: a CPA or EA who prepares Schedule C returns for freelancers and checks that bank-file lines map to the right Schedule C lines, that non-expenses are held out, and that meals are at 50%

evidence.correctness: Ran the built-in sample CSV through normalizeBank+analyze(year 2024) and recomputed by hand. Income: 3820.10+2400+2400 = 8620.10 (tool 8620.10). Expenses: line 8 210.00; line 9 46.12; line 11 650.00; line 18 59.99+35+35 = 129.99; line 24b 18.40 x 50% = 9.20 (IRC 274(n), Pub 535 ch.11); line 25 84.20; sum 1129.51 (tool 1129.51); net 7490.59 (tool 7490.59). Held-out rows (IRS USATAXPYMT, Blue Cross, Netflix, transfer to savings, MacBook 2899 over the 2500 de minimis safe harbor, Reg. 1.263(a)-1(f)) were all outside the totals, as they should be. Printed line numbers in CATEGORIES (1, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 15, 16b, 17, 18, 20b, 21, 22, 23, 24a, 24b, 25, 26, 27a) match the 2024 Schedule C from my knowledge of the form; the IRS form was not fetched. parseNumber('(1,234.50)')=-1234.5 and the European decimal form were correct. Probes found wrong keyword outcomes: 'UBER EATS ORDER' goes to travel (24a, 100%) instead of meals (24b, 50%) because the travel rule precedes meals and matches uber\b; 'MOBILE PAYMENT FEE' goes to car_truck (mobil substring); 'PUBLIC STORAGE' and 'equipment rental' go to 20b although vehicle/machinery/equipment rental is line 20a. Outputs on the sample are right; the rule table has real misfires.
evidence.completeness: README/VENTURE/page claims checked and working: CSV parse with alias columns, debit/credit columns, invert-sign, line 1 receipts, lines 8-27a, meals 50% on 24b, held-out buckets (owner, transfer incl. auto-pairing, est tax, sales tax, loan principal, health insurance, retirement, bank interest, equipment), payout-net-of-fees flag, equipment over-threshold flag, duplicate flag, per-business totals, user rules, CSV download with deciding rule, summary text. All ran. Not done and disclosed: depreciation, home office, mileage, COGS, payroll, SE tax. Line 6 other income exists in CATEGORIES but no built-in rule ever sets it (only a user rule). Stage is 'prototype' in VENTURE.yaml.
evidence.verification: cd ventures/freelancer-schedule-c-categorizer && node --test '*.test.mjs': 35 tests, 35 pass, 0 fail. Seeded mutation 1: MEALS_DEDUCTIBLE 0.5 -> 0.6 in calc.mjs: 1 test failed (caught). Seeded mutation 2: debit/credit combination Math.abs(cr) - Math.abs(dr) changed to +: 1 test failed (caught). Both reverted with git checkout; git status clean. Gap: no test asserts the Uber Eats, 'mobile' or 20a cases, and rule-table tests are sparse (174 lines of calc tests for a 20-category rule table).
evidence.craft: Read calc.mjs (447 lines), calc.test.mjs, usage.mjs, index.html script. Pure functions, no DOM in the engine, CSV formula-injection guard in reportCsv, BOM and UTF-16 decoding, clear errors for missing header. Defects: rule order is the only disambiguation, so substring regexes (mobil, uber\b, sba, fix\b) misfire silently with source 'built-in'; the 'paired' transfer matcher uses find() so the first equal-and-opposite row wins even when several exist; duplicate rows are flagged but still both counted (disclosed in the finding text); CATEGORIES comment says 'the 2024-era form' without per-year handling.
evidence.claims: Checked against files: 'nothing uploaded' is backed by a no-network page test (page.test.mjs) and no fetch in index.html; 50% meals backed by MEALS_DEDUCTIBLE and a test; 'unverified against real bank exports' is stated in README and calc.mjs; disclaimer 'Not tax advice' present on page, README, summaryText and llms.txt; usage tracking present with opt-out (usage.mjs). Small unbacked or stale items: README 'Tests: node --test' does not run on Node 22 (needs the glob form); llms.txt links to the old duncan-haywood.github.io address rather than marisstella.app; canonical, sitemap.xml and robots.txt use relative URLs, which crawlers do not accept (SEO only, not a tax claim).
evidence.fitness: Walked a freelancer's job: export CSV, load, add rules, get line totals and a CSV for the preparer. It works for a clean file, and the held-out list saves a preparer real time. But the user must hand-resolve every uncategorised row, no real bank export was ever tried (alias matching is untested on Chase, Amex, Mercury, Wise formats), there is no COGS, mileage or home-office path, and platform deposits are flagged not grossed up, so a preparer still has to rebuild line 1 from 1099-K and processor reports. Useful starting point, not a finished return-prep workflow.
evidence.domain: Compared against Schedule C (Form 1040) 2024 instructions and Pub 535 / Pub 463 from knowledge, not fetched. Right: 50% meals on 24b; health insurance to Schedule 1 (not Schedule C); SEP/solo 401(k) contributions to Schedule 1; estimated tax, owner draws, sales tax collected and loan principal excluded; bank interest to Schedule B; Stripe/PayPal fees on line 10; equipment held out for Section 179/de minimis decision; the flag that processor payouts are net of fees. Departures: equipment and storage rental lump into 20b (20a is vehicles, machinery, equipment); Uber Eats as travel overstates the deduction by half; no 100%-meal exceptions or 274(n) nuance (acceptable under the flag text); mixed personal/business use is warned (phone, car) but counted at 100%.

defects.what: Delivery-app meals such as 'UBER EATS' are matched by the travel rule (uber\b) before the meals rule, so they are deducted 100% on line 24a instead of 50% on line 24b; the row is labelled a built-in decision with no flag.
Substring 'mobil' in the car_truck rule matches 'mobile' descriptions (e.g. MOBILE PAYMENT FEE becomes line 9 car and truck).
Equipment rental and storage unit rental are put on line 20b; equipment, machinery and vehicle rental belongs on 20a.
Line 6 (other income) can only be reached by a user rule; refunds of expenses (e.g. AMAZON REFUND) land in uncategorised with no guidance.
llms.txt points at the retired github.io address; canonical, sitemap and robots use relative URLs; README test command fails on Node 22.

verdict: A small, honest prototype whose arithmetic is right: on the sample file I recomputed income 8620.10, expenses 1129.51 and net 7490.59 by hand and the tool agreed, the Schedule C line numbers match the 2024 form as I know it, and the held-out buckets match what a preparer would exclude. 35 of 35 tests pass and two seeded mutations (meals rate, debit/credit sign) were each caught. It misses the bar on depth, not honesty: the keyword table has misfires that a preparer would hit in the first hour (Uber Eats deducted at 100% as travel, 'mobile' as car expense, equipment rental on 20b instead of 20a), line 6 is unreachable by built-in rules, and it was never run on a real bank export. Scores are before any fix; the audit meets the numeric bar (correctness, claims and verification all 3) but fitness is 2 and the high-severity meals misroute should be fixed first.
